meta.title: Privacy policy
meta.description: How frankencoin.com handles personal data: hosting logs, Google Analytics with consent, the contact form and your rights.

hero.title: Privacy policy
hero.subtitle: What this website collects, why, and what you can do about it. Last updated 12 November 2026.

sections.title: Who is responsible
paragraphs: This website, frankencoin.com, is operated by the Frankencoin Association (Verein), a Swiss non-profit based in Zug, Switzerland. For anything about personal data, write to info@frankencoin.com.

The Association runs this website only. It does not issue ZCHF, does not control the Frankencoin protocol and does not operate the app at app.frankencoin.com, which has its own terms. Transactions you make on-chain are public by design and are not covered by this policy.

items.title: Server logs
items.text: Our hosting provider records technical access data for every request: IP address, time, page requested, browser type and the referring page. We use it to keep the site running and secure. Logs are kept for a short period and then deleted. Legal basis: our legitimate interest in operating a secure website.

items.title: Analytics, only with your consent
items.text: We use Google Analytics 4 (Google Ireland Ltd.) to see which pages are read and which buttons are used. If you accept analytics in the cookie banner, Google sets cookies (such as _ga) and we see pseudonymous usage data, including a shortened IP address, device and country. Event data is kept for two months, user data for 14 months. If you decline, no analytics cookies are set and no identifier is stored; Google receives only aggregated, cookieless signals that cannot be linked to you. You can change your choice at any time under Cookie settings in the footer. Legal basis: your consent. Google may process data in the United States under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework.

items.title: Contact form
items.text: If you write to us through the contact form, we receive your name, email address, the company or project you name, the topic and your message, together with the page you wrote from. The message is delivered to our inbox through Resend (Resend, Inc.), an email service. We use it only to answer you and keep it as long as the conversation requires. Legal basis: taking steps at your request before a possible cooperation, and our legitimate interest in answering enquiries.

items.title: Protocol data
items.text: Rates, reserves and supply shown on this site come from api.frankencoin.com and the public blockchain. These requests contain no personal data about you beyond the technical access data above.

items.title: Embedded content
items.text: The media page can embed videos from YouTube (Google). The embed loads when you open that page and YouTube may set its own cookies, governed by Google's privacy policy. Links to other sites, including the app and exchanges, lead to services with their own policies.

items.title: fc-consent
items.text: Stores your cookie choice in your browser so we do not ask again. Necessary, kept for 12 months.

items.title: _ga, _ga_*
items.text: Google Analytics, set only after consent. Distinguish visitors and sessions. Kept up to 2 years.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: Under the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection and, where it applies, the EU General Data Protection Regulation, you can ask us which personal data we hold about you, have it corrected or deleted, object to processing based on legitimate interest, and withdraw consent at any time with effect for the future. Write to info@frankencoin.com. You can also complain to the Swiss Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner or to the supervisory authority in your EU country.

sections.title: Changes
paragraphs: We update this policy when the website changes. The date at the top tells you which version you are reading.
